title: Etale torsion cohomological dimension bound
statement:
For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and an integer $c\geq0$, write
$\operatorname{cd}_{\rm tor}(X)\leq c$ if
$H^q(X,F)=0$ for every torsion abelian etale sheaf
$F$ on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]
and every integer $q>c$, where $H^q(X,F)$ is the ordinary
derived-section cohomology group of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].
Here torsion has the local-section meaning of
[def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]: every local section is locally
killed by a positive integer; a single integer annihilating $F$
is not required.
For a field $K$, write $\operatorname{cd}_{\rm tor}(K)\leq c$
for this condition on the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}K$
[def-weil-affine-spectrum].
